problem: Intent authors receive inconsistent semantic-gate results for documented product-target and implementation-location scenarios, so an unchanged intent can alternate between pass and fail.
outcome: Each unchanged documented scenario returns the same verdict across repeated evaluations: product-target scenarios return pass and implementation-location scenarios return fail. Before each release, the release manager must personally execute every calibration scenario three times.
acceptance: Each documented product-target scenario returns pass in repeated evaluations
Each documented implementation-location scenario returns fail in repeated evaluations
Before each release, the release manager personally executes every calibration scenario three times
